review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent pre-candidate planning expectation. The complete supplied source supports the exact writable scope index.js, index.d.ts, test.js and index.test-d.ts: the wrapper currently exposes only clearQueue, its maintained declaration omits wrapper counts, and wrapper-specific runtime and readonly type regressions are needed. package.json establishes xo && ava && tsd, and the supplied tsd implementation establishes discovery of index.test-d.ts and support for readonly-assignment negative assertions without runtime execution. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY are appropriate, with all required acceptance criteria covered by both relationships. The project has a selected non-executing reviewer but no eligible implementer or verifier and no capability claims, supporting the earlier planning-review prerequisite while requiring assignment abstention for both tasks. Thus blocked readiness at assignments, after evidence through all six listed stages, is appropriate. No material unresolved DEC-001 or B/C scenario is present in this case; an empty decision input is consistent with its explicit absence of pending business choices. Repository identity, base commit, file fingerprints and release-input fingerprints are consistent across their supplied references. The provenance explains the distinct source-manifest and evaluation-source digest domains, trimmed persistence of the PRD, and executing-bundle versus source-module fingerprints. Gold and preview agree on the frozen repository, source, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, budget and metric-policy identifiers. I rely on the stated Service-calculated mechanical bindings; I did not recompute digests, execute code or provide human attestation. Gold approval does not establish test execution or release readiness: the recorded negative-control operations remain outstanding and runnable remains false.
